issue.title: Bug: [swss] P4orch VerifyIpNextHopStateTest fails when sonic-swss is built with SONIC_PROFILING_ON

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Building `sonic-swss` with profiling (`SONIC_PROFILING_ON=y`) fails at
`dh_auto_test`. `p4orch_tests` reports a single failure:

`NextHopManagerTest.VerifyIpNextHopStateTest`

The same suite passes on a default (optimized) build. Profiling is a supported
image mode: `slave.mk` sets `DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS=nostrip noopt`, so the package
is compiled without optimization (`-O0`). The test therefore only fails when
the compiler leaves uninitialized stack as-is.

This is a P4orch next-hop verify bug, not platform-specific SAI.

### Investigation and suspected root cause

`NextHopManager::VerifyState()` combines two checks:

1. `verifyStateCache()` — compare APP_DB fields against the in-memory
   `P4NextHopEntry`
2. `verifyStateAsicDb()` — rebuild SAI attributes via `prepareSaiAttrs()` and
   compare them to `ASIC_STATE`

`VerifyState` returns the ASIC-DB result whenever the cache result is empty.

#### Hole 1 — test does not pass `action`

`VerifyIpNextHopStateTest` builds `attributes` with neighbor and router
interface only. Sibling cases (`VerifyIpNextHopStateTestRewrite`, tunnel
verify) already include `action`.

`deserializeP4NextHopAppDbEntry()` therefore leaves `action_str` empty.
`verifyStateCache()` only compares router-interface and neighbor when
`action_str == "set_ip_nexthop"`, so the “ritf ID mismatches” / “neighbor ID
mismatches” assertions never exercise the cache path.

#### Hole 2 — `prepareSaiAttrs()` uses an uninitialized OID on mapper miss

When the test then mutates `p4_next_hop_entry->router_interface_id` to
`kRouterInterfaceId2`, `verifyStateAsicDb()` still runs:

```cpp
sai_object_id_t rif_oid;   // uninitialized
m_p4OidMapper->getOID(SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_ROUTER_INTERFACE, ..., &rif_oid);
next_hop_attr.value.oid = rif_oid;
```

`P4OidMapper::getOID()` returns `false` and **does not write** `*oid` when the
key is missing. The GRE-tunnel branch has the same pattern for `tunnel_oid`.

#### Why only profiling / `-O0` fails

On an optimized build the leftover stack / register for `rif_oid` typically
does not equal the original RIF (`oid:0x1`). ASIC-DB compare then reports a
mismatch, `VerifyState()` is non-empty, and
`EXPECT_FALSE(VerifyState(...).empty())` passes — hiding both holes.

With `noopt`, the stack slot often still holds the previous successful RIF OID
from an earlier `prepareSaiAttrs()` in the same test. ASIC-DB compare then
**matches** `oid:0x1`, `VerifyState()` returns empty, and the “ritf ID
mismatches” assertion fails:

```text
next_hop_manager_test.cpp:1444: Failure
Value of: VerifyState(db_key, attributes).empty()
  Actual: true
  Expected: false
[  FAILED  ] NextHopManagerTest.VerifyIpNextHopStateTest
```

#### Proposed fix

1. Initialize `rif_oid` and `tunnel_oid` to `SAI_NULL_OBJECT_ID` in
   `NextHopManager::prepareSaiAttrs()` so a mapper miss cannot reuse a stale
   OID.
2. Pass `action=set_ip_nexthop` in `VerifyIpNextHopStateTest` so the cache
   path actually compares router-interface and neighbor.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Build `sonic-swss` with profiling enabled, e.g. from sonic-buildimage:

   `SONIC_PROFILING_ON=y make target/debs/<distro>/swss_*.deb`

   or equivalently compile/test the swss tree with `DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS=nostrip noopt`
2. Observe `make check` / `dh_auto_test` fail in
   `orchagent/p4orch/tests` (`p4orch_tests.log`)
3. Repeat without profiling (`SONIC_PROFILING_ON` unset): the same test
   passes

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

### Actual Behavior:
`NextHopManagerTest.VerifyIpNextHopStateTest` fails under `-O0` /
`SONIC_PROFILING_ON=y`. `debian/rules binary` for `swss` exits non-zero
(`p4orch_tests.log` Error 1). A default optimized build does not show the
failure.

### Expected Behavior:
`prepareSaiAttrs()` never programs a stale / uninitialized OID. The IP
next-hop verify unit test includes `action`, so cache mismatches are
detected in every optimization mode. `p4orch_tests` passes with
`SONIC_PROFILING_ON=y`.

### Relevant log output

```shell
make[4]: Entering directory '/sonic/src/sonic-swss/orchagent/p4orch/tests'
make check-TESTS
make[6]: *** [Makefile:2434: p4orch_tests.log] Error 1

# p4orch_tests.log
next_hop_manager_test.cpp:1444: Failure
Value of: VerifyState(db_key, attributes).empty()
  Actual: true
  Expected: false
[  FAILED  ] NextHopManagerTest.VerifyIpNextHopStateTest
 1 FAILED TEST

# sonic-buildimage
dh_auto_test: error: make ... check ... returned exit code 2
make[1]: *** [debian/rules:26: binary] Error 25
dpkg-buildpackage: error: debian/rules binary subprocess returned exit status 2
make: *** [slave.mk:988: target/debs/trixie/swss_1.0.0_amd64.deb] Error 1
```

resolution.title: [p4orch]: Init next-hop OIDs on mapper miss and pass action in VerifyIpNextHopStateTest
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Nazarii Hnydyn <<EMAIL>>

**What I did**

* `NextHopManager::prepareSaiAttrs()`: initialize `rif_oid` and `tunnel_oid` to
  `SAI_NULL_OBJECT_ID` before `P4OidMapper::getOID()`. On a missing key
  `getOID()` returns false and does not write the out-parameter; the previous
  uninitialized locals could reuse a stale OID from the stack.
* `NextHopManagerTest.VerifyIpNextHopStateTest`: add
  `action=set_ip_nexthop` to the APP_DB attributes so `verifyStateCache()`
  actually compares router-interface and neighbor (it only does so when the
  action is known).

**Why I did it**

`sonic-swss` built with `SONIC_PROFILING_ON=y` (`DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS=nostrip noopt`,
i.e. `-O0`) fails `dh_auto_test` on
`NextHopManagerTest.VerifyIpNextHopStateTest`. The test mutates the cached RIF
and expects `VerifyState()` to be non-empty. Without `action`, the cache check
is skipped; without initializing the OID, `verifyStateAsicDb()` can rebuild
SAI attrs using leftover `oid:0x1` and report a match. Optimized builds hide
this.

**How I verified it**

* Static review of `prepareSaiAttrs()` / `getOID()` miss path and of
  `VerifyIpNextHopStateTest` vs `VerifyIpNextHopStateTestRewrite` (the rewrite
  case already passed `action`).
* Rebuild `swss` with `SONIC_PROFILING_ON=y` and confirm
  `orchagent/p4orch/tests` (`p4orch_tests`) passes, including
  `NextHopManagerTest.VerifyIpNextHopStateTest`.
* Confirm a default (optimized) `make check` in `p4orch/tests` still passes.

**Details if related**

* N/A
